description: Public records around a US street address: U.S. Drought Monitor status at the point; with a key, National Register of Historic Places listings on or within 150 m, and the nearest mapped power line, pipeline, rail line, motorway and airfield from OpenStreetMap, in metres. Each item carries its source, record and read date. Mapped, not surveyed: an easement is the title's word. Does not compute the Buildability Score.

property.description: The property being researched: a US street address, e.g. "412 Oak St, Austin, TX".

response_format.description: "concise" (default) leaves out factor notes and verbatim code quotes; every number keeps its source and read date. "detailed" returns them.
